jp: (不気味に胎動している…。)
jp_grezzo: "(不気味に胎動している…。)"
en: (Ethers were discharged to crystallize some.)
en_grezzo: "(Ethers were discharged to crystallize some.)"
it: (Qualcosa si agita là dentro, e mette i brividi...)

jp: (あなたはフロアの中央に巨大な肉塊が鎮座しているのを見つけた)
jp_grezzo: "(あなたはフロアの中央に巨大な肉塊が鎮座しているのを見つけた)"
en: (You discover a massive lump of flesh enshrined in the middle of the floor.)
en_grezzo: "(You discover a massive lump of flesh enshrined in the middle of the floor.)"
it: (Al centro della sala scopri un enorme ammasso di carne, posato come su un altare.)

jp: (それこそが、かつてこの地で産み落とされたメシェーラのオリジナル。生命を無差別に取り込み、星をも食らいつくさんと今も進化を続ける災厄の苗床であった)
jp_grezzo: "(それこそが、かつてこの地で産み落とされたメシェーラのオリジナル。生命を無差別に取り込み、星をも食らいつくさんと今も進化を続ける災厄の苗床であった)"
en: (It is the original Meshera that was born in this place in the distant past. Indiscriminately assimilating other lifeforms, it is the seedbed for the disaster that threatened the world and which even now continues to evolve.)
en_grezzo: "(It is the original Meshera that was born in this place in the distant past. Indiscriminately assimilating other lifeforms, it is the seedbed for the disaster that threatened the world and which even now continues to evolve.)"
it: (È il Meshera originale, nato qui in un'epoca remota. Assimila senza distinzione ogni forma di vita, ed è il vivaio della calamità che ha minacciato il mondo: ancora oggi continua a evolversi.)

jp: 私は後悔していない。あの日、生魂の儀を選択したことを。それが、運命の筋書きに定められたものだったかなんて関係なく、だ。
jp_grezzo: "私は後悔していない。あの日、生魂の儀を選択したことを。それが、運命の筋書きに定められたものだったかなんて関係なく、だ。"
en: I carry no regrets since that day, when I chose to partake in the Healing Ceremony - even if it was an act predetermined by the thread of fate.
en_grezzo: "I carry no regrets since that day, when I chose to partake in the Healing Ceremony - even if it was an act predetermined by the thread of fate."
it: Non mi pento di aver scelto, quel giorno, la Cerimonia di Guarigione. E non importa se era già scritto nel disegno del destino.

jp: エルシアの首飾りは由緒あるお守りだ。旅の安全を祈り、出会った人々の想いを繋げるとされている。…当時はただの気休めだと思っていたが、意外とそうでもなかったようだな。
jp_grezzo: "エルシアの首飾りは由緒あるお守りだ。旅の安全を祈り、出会った人々の想いを繋げるとされている。…当時はただの気休めだと思っていたが、意外とそうでもなかったようだな。"
en: The Elsian Necklace is an artifact that carries a storied history. It is said to act as a prayer for one's safe travels, and that it connects its owner with the memories of the people they meet along the way. ...At the time, I believed that was nothing more than a gesture of comfort, but to my surprise, it seems like that wasn't the case.
en_grezzo: "The Elsian Necklace is an artifact that carries a storied history. It is said to act as a prayer for one's safe travels, and that it connects its owner with the memories of the people they meet along the way. ...At the time, I believed that was nothing more than a gesture of comfort, but to my surprise, it seems like that wasn't the case."
it: La collana di Elsia è un artefatto con una lunga storia. Si dice che sia una preghiera per la sicurezza del viaggio, e che leghi chi la porta al ricordo delle persone incontrate lungo la strada. ...All'epoca la ritenevo solo una consolazione, ma a quanto pare mi sbagliavo.

jp: 伝説って？
jp_grezzo: "伝説って？"
en: What sort of legend are you referring to?
en_grezzo: "What sort of legend are you referring to?"
it: Che leggenda?

jp: 光に包まれてこちらの世界に飛ばされた際、何者かが私たちの前に現れた。声も姿もおぼろげでよくわからなかったが、運命がどうとか言っていた。もしかすると伝説のノルンだったのかもしれないな。
jp_grezzo: "光に包まれてこちらの世界に飛ばされた際、何者かが私たちの前に現れた。声も姿もおぼろげでよくわからなかったが、運命がどうとか言っていた。もしかすると伝説のノルンだったのかもしれないな。"
en: Just as we were enveloped in light and transported to this world, someone appeared in front of us. I couldn't make out its voice or figure, but it said something about fate. Maybe it was the legendary Norne.
en_grezzo: "Just as we were enveloped in light and transported to this world, someone appeared in front of us. I couldn't make out its voice or figure, but it said something about fate. Maybe it was the legendary Norne."
it: Quando la luce ci ha avvolti e ci ha scagliati in questo mondo, qualcuno è comparso davanti a noi. Non ne ho distinto né la voce né la figura, ma parlava di destino. Forse era la leggendaria Norne.

jp: ああ、すまない。こちら側の住人にガイアス・ヴィスの伝説はわからないか。ノルンとは、運命の女神とその末裔…巨人族のアールン、妖精族のエルン、小人族のドヴァルン。その総称だ。古神戦争によって大多数が死滅したが、生き残りが運命を見通し人を導くとされている。
jp_grezzo: "ああ、すまない。こちら側の住人にガイアス・ヴィスの伝説はわからないか。ノルンとは、運命の女神とその末裔…巨人族のアールン、妖精族のエルン、小人族のドヴァルン。その総称だ。古神戦争によって大多数が死滅したが、生き残りが運命を見通し人を導くとされている。"
en: Oh, I'm sorry. Do the inhabitants of this side of the world not know the legend of Gaius Vis? \"Norne\" is a general term that refers to the the goddess of destiny and her descendants: the giants named Ahlung, the fairies named Eln, and the dwarves named Dovarn. The majority of them died in the Old Gods War, but the survivors are said to guide people to their destiny.
en_grezzo: "Oh, I'm sorry. Do the inhabitants of this side of the world not know the legend of Gaius Vis? \"Norne\" is a general term that refers to the the goddess of destiny and her descendants: the giants named Ahlung, the fairies named Eln, and the dwarves named Dovarn. The majority of them died in the Old Gods War, but the survivors are said to guide people to their destiny."
it: Ah, chiedo scusa: da questa parte del mondo la leggenda di Gaius Vis non la conoscete. \"Norne\" è il nome collettivo della dea del destino e della sua discendenza: gli Ahlung, stirpe dei giganti; gli Eln, stirpe delle fate; i Dovarn, stirpe dei nani. La Guerra delle Divinità Antiche ne ha sterminati quasi tutti, ma si dice che i sopravvissuti leggano il destino e guidino gli uomini.

jp: パルミア、エウダーナ、エーテルの風…
jp_grezzo: "パルミア、エウダーナ、エーテルの風…"
en: Palmia, Eulderna, Etherwind...
en_grezzo: "Palmia, Eulderna, Etherwind..."
it: Palmia, Eulderna, il vento d'etere...

jp: この世界…イルヴァといったか。どうやら我々の世界ガイアス・ヴィスとまったく無関係というわけではなさそうだな。使命さえなければじっくり調査をしたいところだ。
jp_grezzo: "この世界…イルヴァといったか。どうやら我々の世界ガイアス・ヴィスとまったく無関係というわけではなさそうだな。使命さえなければじっくり調査をしたいところだ。"
en: This world... Irva, it's called. It appears it's not entirely independent of my own world of Gaius Vis. Despite my mission, I can't help but want to investigate it.
en_grezzo: "This world... Irva, it's called. It appears it's not entirely independent of my own world of Gaius Vis. Despite my mission, I can't help but want to investigate it."
it: Questo mondo... Irva, si chiama. A quanto pare non è del tutto estraneo al mio, a Gaius Vis. Se non avessi una missione, mi ci metterei a indagare con calma.

jp: それにしてもこの世界はどこかおかしい。死人や瀕死の怪我人が、生魂の儀もなしに自然回復するのだから。誰も疑問に思わないのか？
jp_grezzo: "それにしてもこの世界はどこかおかしい。死人や瀕死の怪我人が、生魂の儀もなしに自然回復するのだから。誰も疑問に思わないのか？"
en: That said, something about this world is funny. The dead and dying can be recovered without the Healing Ceremony. Doesn't anyone find that odd?
en_grezzo: "That said, something about this world is funny. The dead and dying can be recovered without the Healing Ceremony. Doesn't anyone find that odd?"
it: Eppure qualcosa non torna, qui. I morti e i moribondi si rimettono da soli, senza Cerimonia di Guarigione. Possibile che nessuno se lo chieda?

jp: 私…？ええ、少し考え事をしていたの。
jp_grezzo: "私…？ええ、少し考え事をしていたの。"
en: Me...? Well, I was just thinking about something.
en_grezzo: "Me...? Well, I was just thinking about something."
it: Io...? Sì, stavo solo pensando a una cosa.

jp: カルラに聞いた話だ
jp_grezzo: "カルラに聞いた話だ"
en: You told me that story.
en_grezzo: "You told me that story."
it: Me l'hai raccontata tu

jp: ラーネイレに聞いた童話だ
jp_grezzo: "ラーネイレに聞いた童話だ"
en: That was a fairy-tale Larnneire told me.
en_grezzo: "That was a fairy-tale Larnneire told me."
it: È una fiaba che mi ha raccontato Larnneire

jp: よくわからなかった話だ
jp_grezzo: "よくわからなかった話だ"
en: I didn't really understand that story.
en_grezzo: "I didn't really understand that story."
it: Non l'ho capita bene

jp: あなたは、獣に変えられた王子の話を覚えているかしら。
jp_grezzo: "あなたは、獣に変えられた王子の話を覚えているかしら。"
en: Would you happen to remember the story of the prince who was turned into a beast?
en_grezzo: "Would you happen to remember the story of the prince who was turned into a beast?"
it: Te la ricordi la storia del principe trasformato in bestia?

jp: たとえ姿が…いえ、全てが変わったとしても。あなたが、あなたであったことには変わりない。今の私にはそう思えるの。
jp_grezzo: "たとえ姿が…いえ、全てが変わったとしても。あなたが、あなたであったことには変わりない。今の私にはそう思えるの。"
en: Even if my appearance... no, even if everything about me has changed, that will never change the fact that you were always you. That is what I now believe.
en_grezzo: "Even if my appearance... no, even if everything about me has changed, that will never change the fact that you were always you. That is what I now believe."
it: Anche se l'aspetto... no, anche se tutto è cambiato. Che tu fossi tu, questo non cambia. Adesso lo penso davvero.

jp: こちら側にも同じ話があるのね。いえ、彼女だからこそ、なのかしら。
jp_grezzo: "こちら側にも同じ話があるのね。いえ、彼女だからこそ、なのかしら。"
en: Yes, that same story is also told in this land. Well, perhaps she is the very reason for that.
en_grezzo: "Yes, that same story is also told in this land. Well, perhaps she is the very reason for that."
it: Anche da questa parte la raccontano, allora. O forse è proprio per via di lei.

jp: …ごめんなさい。あなたには、まだ、この意味はわからないわね。
jp_grezzo: "…ごめんなさい。あなたには、まだ、この意味はわからないわね。"
en: ...My apologies. It seems that you have yet to grasp the meaning of that story.
en_grezzo: "...My apologies. It seems that you have yet to grasp the meaning of that story."
it: ...Perdonami. Il senso di quella storia, tu, non l'hai ancora afferrato.

jp: その首飾りは…。ちょっと見せてもらえるかしら。
jp_grezzo: "その首飾りは…。ちょっと見せてもらえるかしら。"
en: That necklace... May I see it for a moment?
en_grezzo: "That necklace... May I see it for a moment?"
it: Quella collana... me la fai vedere un momento?

jp: この傷、この彫刻…。間違いないわ、これはあの日助けた旅人に…いえ、「旅人たち」に渡してきた物。
jp_grezzo: "この傷、この彫刻…。間違いないわ、これはあの日助けた旅人に…いえ、「旅人たち」に渡してきた物。"
en: These scratches, these engravings... There's no doubt about it. This is the very artifact I gave to that traveler... no, those \"travelers\" that saved me on that day.
en_grezzo: "These scratches, these engravings... There's no doubt about it. This is the very artifact I gave to that traveler... no, those \"travelers\" that saved me on that day."
it: Questi graffi, questi intagli... Non ci sono dubbi: è proprio l'oggetto che diedi al viandante che quel giorno mi salvò... no, ai \"viandanti\".

jp: そう、あなたがそうだったのね。
jp_grezzo: "そう、あなたがそうだったのね。"
en: That's right. It was you, wasn't it?
en_grezzo: "That's right. It was you, wasn't it?"
it: Ecco. Eri tu, vero?

jp: ミロスと合流できたのはいいけれど、こちら側に来てから相当年月が過ぎているわ。もし時間の流れが同じだとしたら…今頃、森の異変はどうなっているのかしら。考えるだけで恐ろしいわ。
jp_grezzo: "ミロスと合流できたのはいいけれど、こちら側に来てから相当年月が過ぎているわ。もし時間の流れが同じだとしたら…今頃、森の異変はどうなっているのかしら。考えるだけで恐ろしいわ。"
en: It is nice to be able to join with Miros, but it's been a long time since I came here. If the flow of time is the same... I wonder what is going on about the accident in the forest at this time. Just thinking is horrible.
en_grezzo: "It is nice to be able to join with Miros, but it's been a long time since I came here. If the flow of time is the same... I wonder what is going on about the accident in the forest at this time. Just thinking is horrible."
it: Ritrovare Milos è stato bello, ma da quando sono arrivata qui sono passati parecchi anni. Se il tempo scorre allo stesso modo... chissà a che punto è adesso la sciagura della foresta. A pensarci mi si gela il sangue.

jp: あ、あなたは！？
jp_grezzo: "あ、あなたは！？"
en: Y-you are?!
en_grezzo: "Y-you are?!"
it: M-ma tu...?!

jp: …ごめんなさい、人違いだわ。昔助けた冒険者と雰囲気が似ていたから間違えてしまったの。
jp_grezzo: "…ごめんなさい、人違いだわ。昔助けた冒険者と雰囲気が似ていたから間違えてしまったの。"
en: ...I'm sorry. I thought you were someone else. You remind me of an adventurer who helped me out long ago.
en_grezzo: "...I'm sorry. I thought you were someone else. You remind me of an adventurer who helped me out long ago."
it: ...Perdonami, mi sono sbagliata. Assomigli a chi, tanto tempo fa, mi diede una mano.

jp: この土地に流れ着いてから色々な人に話を聞いたけれど、どうやらこの世界は私のいた世界ではないようね。早くガイアス・ヴィスに帰ってザビ王に謁見しなければならないのだけれど、どうやって帰ればいいのかしら？ミロスともはぐれてしまったし…。
jp_grezzo: "この土地に流れ着いてから色々な人に話を聞いたけれど、どうやらこの世界は私のいた世界ではないようね。早くガイアス・ヴィスに帰ってザビ王に謁見しなければならないのだけれど、どうやって帰ればいいのかしら？ミロスともはぐれてしまったし…。"
en: From what I've gathered from the many people I've spoken to since washing ashore, this world is not my own. I want to hurry back to Gaius Vis since I have an audience with King Zabi, but how can I return to my world? Not only that, but Milos has gone missing as well...
en_grezzo: "From what I've gathered from the many people I've spoken to since washing ashore, this world is not my own. I want to hurry back to Gaius Vis since I have an audience with King Zabi, but how can I return to my world? Not only that, but Milos has gone missing as well..."
it: Da quando sono approdata qui ho parlato con molta gente, e a quanto pare questo non è il mio mondo. Dovrei tornare in fretta a Gaius Vis, ho udienza da re Zabi... ma come ci si torna? E poi ho perso anche Milos...

jp: 音楽チケット
jp_grezzo: "音楽チケット"
en: Music tickets
en_grezzo: "Music tickets"
it: Scambiare i biglietti

jp: やれやれ、昔はここも美しく静かな街だったのに。観光客が増えたおかげで騒がしくて仕方がありません。賑やかになったと孫は喜んでますが。
jp_grezzo: "やれやれ、昔はここも美しく静かな街だったのに。観光客が増えたおかげで騒がしくて仕方がありません。賑やかになったと孫は喜んでますが。"
en: My goodness... This used to be such a beautiful and quiet town. That all went to hell once those tourists started coming here. At least my grandson enjoys the liveliness.
en_grezzo: "My goodness... This used to be such a beautiful and quiet town. That all went to hell once those tourists started coming here. At least my grandson enjoys the liveliness."
it: Ahimè... una volta questa era una città bella e tranquilla. Da quando arrivano i turisti, un baccano insopportabile. Mio nipote, però, è contento che ci sia vita.

jp: 音楽チケットを持っているのですか？パーティを開催しようにも切らして困っていたのです。わたしの特別なコレクションと交換してくれませんか？
jp_grezzo: "音楽チケットを持っているのですか？パーティを開催しようにも切らして困っていたのです。わたしの特別なコレクションと交換してくれませんか？"
en: You have some music tickets? It's always troubling to run out when I want to hold parties. Would you be interested in trading them for something from my special collection?
en_grezzo: "You have some music tickets? It's always troubling to run out when I want to hold parties. Would you be interested in trading them for something from my special collection?"
it: Hai dei biglietti per il concerto? Restarne senza quando voglio dare una festa è sempre una seccatura. Ti andrebbe di scambiarli con qualcosa della mia collezione speciale?

jp: 今思うと、イトコのフロンとリアにも来てもらうべきでしたね。下見ついでに混沌の神も倒せて一石二鳥だったかもしれません。
jp_grezzo: "今思うと、イトコのフロンとリアにも来てもらうべきでしたね。下見ついでに混沌の神も倒せて一石二鳥だったかもしれません。"
en: Now that I think about it, I should have asked my cousins Fron and Leah to come along also. We could have killed two birds with one stone by defeating the God of Chaos while also having ourselves a tour of the place.
en_grezzo: "Now that I think about it, I should have asked my cousins Fron and Leah to come along also. We could have killed two birds with one stone by defeating the God of Chaos while also having ourselves a tour of the place."
it: A pensarci adesso, avrei dovuto farmi accompagnare anche dalle cugine, Fron e Leah. Fra un sopralluogo e l'altro magari abbattevamo pure il dio del caos: due piccioni con una fava.

jp: 妹のエールと一緒にツアーの下見に来たんですが、ここで貧弱なお客様を守りながら戦うのは至難の業ですね…。
jp_grezzo: "妹のエールと一緒にツアーの下見に来たんですが、ここで貧弱なお客様を守りながら戦うのは至難の業ですね…。"
en: I came here with my younger sister Aile to do a dry run of the tour, but it's extremely difficult to fight while protecting these frail customers...
en_grezzo: "I came here with my younger sister Aile to do a dry run of the tour, but it's extremely difficult to fight while protecting these frail customers..."
it: Sono venuta con mia sorella minore Aile per un sopralluogo del percorso, ma combattere proteggendo dei clienti così fragili è un'impresa disperata...

jp: というか、妹がどんどん先に行くのではぐれてしまいました。か弱い姉を置きざりにするなんてどんな判断だ！
jp_grezzo: "というか、妹がどんどん先に行くのではぐれてしまいました。か弱い姉を置きざりにするなんてどんな判断だ！"
en: In fact, I got separated from my sister because she kept going on ahead of me. What on earth was she thinking, leaving her weak and helpless big sis behind!
en_grezzo: "In fact, I got separated from my sister because she kept going on ahead of me. What on earth was she thinking, leaving her weak and helpless big sis behind!"
it: Anzi: mia sorella tirava dritto e mi ha seminata. Che ragionamenti fa, a piantare qui la sua povera sorella maggiore?!

jp: ツアーガイドたるもの、どんなところだろうと観光案内できなくてはなりません。あらゆる環境を案内できるように己を鍛え上げ、襲いくる野盗や怪物との戦闘をむしろお客様向けのショーにできるような者だけが、このイルヴァでツアーガイドを務められるのです。
jp_grezzo: "ツアーガイドたるもの、どんなところだろうと観光案内できなくてはなりません。あらゆる環境を案内できるように己を鍛え上げ、襲いくる野盗や怪物との戦闘をむしろお客様向けのショーにできるような者だけが、このイルヴァでツアーガイドを務められるのです。"
en: To be a tour guide, you must be capable of traveling everywhere in Irva. Only those who have trained their bodies, who are capable of guiding others through any terrain in Irva, and who are able to fight powerful monsters to put on a show for their customers are fit to be tour guides.
en_grezzo: "To be a tour guide, you must be capable of traveling everywhere in Irva. Only those who have trained their bodies, who are capable of guiding others through any terrain in Irva, and who are able to fight powerful monsters to put on a show for their customers are fit to be tour guides."
it: Una guida turistica deve saper accompagnare i clienti dovunque. Solo chi si è temprato al punto da guidarli in qualunque ambiente, e da trasformare lo scontro con banditi e mostri in uno spettacolo per i clienti, può fare la guida turistica qui a Irva.

jp: ネフィア探索は添乗員の専門外なんですけどねぇ…。
jp_grezzo: "ネフィア探索は添乗員の専門外なんですけどねぇ…。"
en: Nefia expeditions aren't this tour guide's area of expertise...
en_grezzo: "Nefia expeditions aren't this tour guide's area of expertise..."
it: Le Nefia non sono roba da assistente di volo...

jp: うーん。気が付いたらお姉ちゃんがいない…。
jp_grezzo: "うーん。気が付いたらお姉ちゃんがいない…。"
en: Hmmm. All of a sudden, my sister is nowhere to be found...
en_grezzo: "Hmmm. All of a sudden, my sister is nowhere to be found..."
it: Uhm. Mi guardo intorno e mia sorella non c'è più...

jp: お姉ちゃんは昔から私達の中でもどんくさい感じでしたので。ちんたらしてて迷子になったんでしょうね。やれやれ。
jp_grezzo: "お姉ちゃんは昔から私達の中でもどんくさい感じでしたので。ちんたらしてて迷子になったんでしょうね。やれやれ。"
en: My older sister has always been the dunce of the family. She must have gotten herself lost by deciding to take a nice little stroll somewhere. What a bother...
en_grezzo: "My older sister has always been the dunce of the family. She must have gotten herself lost by deciding to take a nice little stroll somewhere. What a bother..."
it: Mia sorella maggiore è sempre stata la più imbranata di noi. Si sarà persa a girellare da qualche parte. Che pazienza...
